integrity_statement: The theorem has an analytic proof. Supplementary finite numerical tests are not relied upon for any universal assertion. Qualitative cusp statements and monomial special cases already in the literature are not claimed as novel.
scientific_limitations: All analytic disk selfmaps are admitted only when the zero at the origin has finite order at least two.
Only the local Berezin-range vertical profile and leading Taylor coefficient modulus are recovered, not the full symbol.
Independent mathematical validation and conclusive publication priority have not been performed.
title: Sharp Berezin cusp-width law for superattracting Hardy composition symbols
